result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered, but one clear layout defect is present: the middle card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned relative to its neighbors, pushing its image, title, and delivery fee text noticeably lower than the adjacent cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is shifted down by roughly 25–30px compared to the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards. Its image top edge, time badge, restaurant name, and '€2.40 delivery' line all sit lower than the sibling cards, breaking the row's alignment and making the carousel look broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all carousel items share the same top alignment (e.g., align-items: flex-start on the row container, remove any stray top margin/padding on the second card) so images, titles, and delivery fee lines line up horizontally across all cards.
